Wanna "Diana's Quest: From Princess to Peasant" H-scenes in your pocket and check the game's backstage?


This DLC contains a PDF with all H-scenes presented in the game and backstage (in terms of art). You'll be able to check how we created the characters, their sketches, and much more. In other words, you'll get:

  • A PDF with all H-scenes presented in the game and backstage, including sketches from the scenes and characters' art process!

↳ To access it, you need to go to the location:
📁 C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Diana's Quest: From Princess to Peasant\Diana's Quest - Adult Art Pack.pdf
